subject.title: [Bug] v2026.6.6 cron migration: jobs migrated from jobs.json have blank agent_id — scheduler silently skips them

question: Should legacy cron jobs without an explicit agentId be permanently migrated to the configured default agent, or should blank persisted ownership remain valid through runtime fallback semantics?
rationale: Direct fix attempts chose different layers and are closed unmerged; current main still mixes nullable persisted ownership with fallback runtime semantics, so the permanent upgrade contract needs maintainer intent.

options.title: Migrate to configured default agent
options.body: Doctor or the legacy migration path rewrites blank cron ownership to the configured default agent and adds upgrade proof for multi-agent stores.

options.title: Codify fallback semantics
options.body: Keep persisted rows blank but make scheduler, list, manual run, diagnostics, and docs consistently treat blank ownership as default-agent-owned.

recommendation.title: Migrate to configured default agent
recommendation.body: Doctor or the legacy migration path rewrites blank cron ownership to the configured default agent and adds upgrade proof for multi-agent stores.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest live history on the cron SQLite persistence and doctor migration boundary that needs the product decision.
